_about: Piece names per sheet in reading order (rows top→bottom, then left→right). v2 (profile): every body piece comes from zeus_exploded, an edit of the profile figure zeus_side, so all pieces share one scale and the chibi proportions. The surprised/shout heads come from zeus_parts_a, scaled to the exploded head. copies: the far limbs, darkened. trim: [top, bottom] fractions of a piece's height cut away (joint caps that would show at a joint that barely bends, like the waist); pivots stay where they were measured.
